title: CI's silent-undo step reads the PR body and the cited run, so a Retire-run cite clears a debt delete in CI too
why: #1677 lets the local silent-undo check accept a valid Retire-run line, but CI's step does not read the PR body or the cited run, so CI still refuses.
note: Fix: the CI step reads the PR body through an env var and the cited run through merge.py's reader. Stacked on #1677. Coordinator 18:39 CST Nov 7. Built as draft #1712; the lane handed it to runner 8 (coordinator 20:58 CST: all of its PRs are handed off). PR mapping read from the PR titles and bodies, 20:59 CST Nov 7. Its PR #1712 was closed unmerged 2026-11-08, and main has no --pr-body-env (read 07:38 CST Nov 12). #1969 carries the work; lane fan-prose-unmapped-4 may carry it forward (coordinator pick 1, 07:31 CST).
